title: Selected work
subtitle: Systems we have built, the problems they solved, and the outcomes they produced.

items.title: Missed Call Text-Back System
items.summary: When a salon misses a call, an automated SMS fires within 60 seconds: "Hey! Sorry we missed you. We'd love to help — book online here [link] or reply and we'll call you back." Captures leads that would otherwise call the next salon.

items.title: No-Show Recovery Automation
items.summary: When a client no-shows, an automated sequence fires: immediate SMS, follow-up 24hrs later, rebook offer 3 days later. Includes a special offer trigger if the client hasn't rebooked in 7 days.

items.title: Automated Review Request System
items.summary: 2 hours after appointment completion, client receives an SMS: "Thanks for visiting [Salon]! We'd love your feedback — [Google Review Link]." Timing is key — 2hrs beats same-day and next-day in conversion.

items.title: Appointment Reminder Sequence
items.summary: 48hr reminder + 2hr reminder before every appointment. Includes a confirm/cancel button in the SMS. If cancelled, triggers an instant rebook offer and notifies the stylist to fill the slot.

items.title: Win-Back Campaign for Inactive Clients
items.summary: Automatically identifies clients who haven't booked in 60 days and sends a personalized SMS: "We miss you at [Salon]! It's been a while — here's 15% off your next visit: [book link]." Runs on autopilot monthly.

items.title: AI Receptionist — Inbound Call Handling
items.summary: AI voice agent answers calls 24/7, handles FAQs (hours, pricing, availability), books appointments directly into Vagaro/Fresha, and texts a booking confirmation. Fully trained on the salon's services and staff.

items.title: New Client Welcome Sequence
items.summary: When a new client books for the first time, an automated 3-message sequence fires over 7 days: welcome message, pre-appointment tips, and a post-visit check-in with a review request.

items.title: Instagram DM Auto-Response for Bookings
items.summary: When a potential client DMs the salon's Instagram asking about availability or pricing, AI auto-responds with relevant info and a booking link. Captures leads from social that currently get lost.

items.title: Speed-to-Lead AI Response System
items.summary: New lead from Zillow/Realtor.com triggers an AI SMS within 60 seconds: personalized to the property they inquired about, asks 3 qualifying questions (budget, timeline, pre-approved?), and routes hot leads to the agent instantly.

items.title: Cold Lead Re-Engagement Sequence
items.summary: Leads that went cold (no response in 14+ days) enter an automated 6-touch sequence over 30 days: market updates, new listings matching their criteria, price drop alerts. Runs without the agent lifting a finger.

items.title: AI Lead Qualification Chatbot
items.summary: Website or landing page chatbot that qualifies leads 24/7: asks about budget, location, timeline, financing status. Scores leads as hot/warm/cold and alerts the agent only for hot leads. Syncs to CRM automatically.

items.title: Post-Showing Follow-Up Automation
items.summary: After every showing, automated SMS fires to the buyer: "Thanks for viewing [address] today! Any questions? Ready to make an offer? [Book a call link]." If no response in 48hrs, a second message goes out with a market comparison.

items.title: CRM Auto-Population from Lead Sources
items.summary: Every new lead from Zillow, Realtor.com, Instagram, and referrals automatically creates a contact in Follow Up Boss/Wise Agent — tagged by source, assigned a follow-up sequence, and alerted to the agent. Zero manual data entry.

items.title: AI Voice Agent for Inbound Inquiries
items.summary: AI answers calls from new inquiries 24/7, qualifies the lead (budget, timeline, pre-approval), books a callback with the agent, and texts a confirmation. Agent only speaks to pre-qualified, ready-to-talk leads.

items.title: Listing Alert Automation for Buyer Leads
items.summary: When a new listing matches a buyer's saved criteria, an automated personalized SMS fires within minutes: "New listing just hit matching your search — 3bed/2bath in [area] at $X. Want to schedule a showing? [link]"

items.title: Referral Request Automation
items.summary: 30 days after a successful closing, an automated personalized message goes to the buyer/seller: "Congrats again on your new home! If you know anyone buying or selling, I'd love to help them too. [Referral link]." Runs for every closed deal automatically.

items.title: AI Chatbot for Website FAQ
items.summary: Trained on a business's actual services, pricing, and policies. Answers customer questions 24/7, captures lead info, and escalates to a human when needed. Works for both salon and real estate websites.

items.title: Google Review Response Automation
items.summary: AI automatically generates and posts personalized responses to every new Google review — positive and negative. Responses are written in the business owner's tone and voice, reviewed before posting.

items.title: WhatsApp Business Automation
items.summary: Auto-responds to WhatsApp inquiries, sends appointment confirmations, shares service menus or property listings, and follows up after interactions. Particularly effective for UK market where WhatsApp is dominant.
